decisions.decision: Raise Pro pricing to $29 for new customers and grandfather existing Pro customers for 6 months.

source.speaker: Nina Patel
source.quote: Proposal: raise the Pro plan from $19 to $29 next month. Trial conversion is healthy, but support load per Pro customer is much higher than expected.

reasoning.claim: Support load per Pro customer is much higher than expected.

source.speaker: Marco Silva
source.quote: I support the increase. At $19, gross margin on Pro is below target once onboarding calls are included. The tradeoff is we may lose some price-sensitive solo users.

objections.claim: Surprising existing customers is a concern.

source.speaker: Aisha Rahman
source.quote: I'm worried about surprising existing customers. Assuming we grandfather current Pro users for 6 months, the support team can handle the messaging.
